title_zh: 維斯帕拉德 第 22 章

segments.orig:
ashem vohû...(3).
ava aibigara ava aibijareta ýâ ameshanãm speñtanãm
saoshyañtãmca ashaonãm gave adhâish
tâish shyaothnâish ýâish vahishtâish
fraêshyâmahi,
segments.en:
With this chant (fully) chanted, and which is for the Bountiful
Immortals and the holy Saoshyants (who are the prophets who shall
serve us), and by means of these (ceremonial) actions, which are
(of all) 
the best, we desire to utter our supplications for the 
Kine. It is that chant which the saint has recognized 
as good and fruitful of blessed gifts, and which the 
sinner does not know.
May we never reach that (ill-luck that the sinner) may outstrip
us (in our chanting), not in the matter of a plan (thought out),
or of words (delivered), or ceremonies (done), nor yet in any
offering whatever when he (?) approaches (us for harm).
segments.zh:
以此咒語（完全）誦讀，且為豐盛的
不朽者和聖薩奧希揚特（誰是將要的先知
服務我們)，並且透過這些（儀式的）行動，它們是
(一切的
最好的，我們希望傾誠祈禱
牛隻。這是聖者所認證的咒語。
如同美好且結實纍纍的蒙祝福的恩賜，而罪人不知曉的。
罪人不知曉。
願我們永不達到那（不幸的是罪人）可能超越
我們的（在我們的詩誦中），不在計畫（思慮出）的事項上，
或言辭（傳達的），或儀式（進行的），也不在任何
供奉無論何時當他（？）接近（我們以求傷害）。
